answer.rationale: Verify the incumbent’s delivery-continuity record and the alternative vendor’s actual onboarding and cost performance. With expiry in 14 days, no auto-renewal, and the line at 94% committed volume without buffer, an immediate primary switch could increase delivery risk. Renewal currently best protects total downstream value, although the 18% savings mandate remains unresolved and the alternative vendor’s present capacity and delivery reliability are not yet established.
